translations.en.sahih: When the sky has split [open]
translations.en.pickthall: When the heaven is split asunder
translations.en.yusufali: When the sky is rent asunder,
translations.id.indonesian: Apabila langit terbelah,

transliteration: Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat

translations.en.sahih: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
translations.en.pickthall: And attentive to her Lord in fear,
translations.en.yusufali: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord, and it must needs (do so);-
translations.id.indonesian: dan patuh kepada Tuhannya, dan sudah semestinya langit itu patuh,

translations.en.sahih: And when the earth has been extended
translations.en.pickthall: And when the earth is spread out
translations.en.yusufali: And when the earth is flattened out,
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila bumi diratakan,

transliteration: Wa alqat maa feehaa wa takhallat

translations.en.sahih: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
translations.en.pickthall: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty
translations.en.yusufali: And casts forth what is within it and becomes (clean) empty,
translations.id.indonesian: dan dilemparkan apa yang ada di dalamnya dan menjadi kosong,

transliteration: Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat

translations.en.sahih: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -
translations.en.pickthall: And attentive to her Lord in fear!
translations.en.yusufali: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord,- and it must needs (do so);- (then will come Home the full reality).
translations.id.indonesian: dan patuh kepada Tuhannya, dan sudah semestinya bumi itu patuh, (pada waktu itu manusia akan mengetahui akibat perbuatannya).

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
transliteration: Yaaa ayyuhal insaanu innaka kaadihun ilaa Rabbika kad han famulaaqeeh

translations.en.sahih: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
translations.en.pickthall: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).
translations.en.yusufali: O thou man! Verily thou art ever toiling on towards thy Lord- painfully toiling,- but thou shalt meet Him.
translations.id.indonesian: Hai manusia, sesungguhnya kamu telah bekerja dengan sungguh-sungguh menuju Tuhanmu, maka pasti kamu akan menemui-Nya.

transliteration: Fa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenih

translations.en.sahih: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
translations.en.pickthall: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand
translations.en.yusufali: Then he who is given his Record in his right hand,
translations.id.indonesian: Adapun orang yang diberikan kitabnya dari sebelah kanannya,

translations.en.sahih: He will be judged with an easy account
translations.en.pickthall: He truly will receive an easy reckoning
translations.en.yusufali: Soon will his account be taken by an easy reckoning,
translations.id.indonesian: maka dia akan diperiksa dengan pemeriksaan yang mudah,

translations.en.sahih: And return to his people in happiness.
translations.en.pickthall: And will return unto his folk in joy.
translations.en.yusufali: And he will turn to his people, rejoicing!
translations.id.indonesian: dan dia akan kembali kepada kaumnya (yang sama-sama beriman) dengan gembira.

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
transliteration: Wa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo waraaa'a zahrih

translations.en.sahih: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
translations.en.pickthall: But whoso is given his account behind his back,
translations.en.yusufali: But he who is given his Record behind his back,-
translations.id.indonesian: Adapun orang-orang yang diberikan kitabnya dari belakang,

translations.en.sahih: He will cry out for destruction
translations.en.pickthall: He surely will invoke destruction
translations.en.yusufali: Soon will he cry for perdition,
translations.id.indonesian: maka dia akan berteriak: "Celakalah aku".

translations.en.sahih: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
translations.en.pickthall: And be thrown to scorching fire.
translations.en.yusufali: And he will enter a Blazing Fire.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan dia akan masuk ke dalam api yang menyala-nyala (neraka).

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
translations.en.pickthall: He verily lived joyous with his folk,
translations.en.yusufali: Truly, did he go about among his people, rejoicing!
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya dia dahulu (di dunia) bergembira di kalangan kaumnya (yang sama-sama kafir).

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah].
translations.en.pickthall: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah).
translations.en.yusufali: Truly, did he think that he would not have to return (to Us)!
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya dia menyangka bahwa dia sekali-kali tidak akan kembali (kepada Tuhannya).

arabic: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
transliteration: Balaaa inna Rabbahoo kaana bihee baseeraa

translations.en.sahih: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him!
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, nay! for his Lord was (ever) watchful of him!
translations.id.indonesian: (Bukan demikian), yang benar, sesungguhnya Tuhannya selalu melihatnya.

translations.en.sahih: So I swear by the twilight glow
translations.en.pickthall: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,
translations.en.yusufali: So I do call to witness the ruddy glow of Sunset;
translations.id.indonesian: Maka sesungguhnya Aku bersumpah dengan cahaya merah di waktu senja,

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the night and what it envelops
translations.en.pickthall: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth,
translations.en.yusufali: The Night and its Homing;
translations.id.indonesian: dan dengan malam dan apa yang diselubunginya,

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
translations.en.pickthall: And by the moon when she is at the full,
translations.en.yusufali: And the Moon in her fullness:
translations.id.indonesian: dan dengan bulan apabila jadi purnama,

translations.en.sahih: [That] you will surely experience state after state.
translations.en.pickthall: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.
translations.en.yusufali: Ye shall surely travel from stage to stage.
translations.id.indonesian: sesungguhnya kamu melalui tingkat demi tingkat (dalam kehidupan),

translations.en.sahih: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,
translations.en.pickthall: What aileth them, then, that they believe not
translations.en.yusufali: What then is the matter with them, that they believe not?-
translations.id.indonesian: Mengapa mereka tidak mau beriman?

arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
transliteration: Wa izaa quri'a 'alaihimul Quraanu laa yasjudoon

translations.en.sahih: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]?
translations.en.pickthall: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)?
translations.en.yusufali: And when the Qur'an is read to them, they fall not prostrate,
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila Al Quran dibacakan kepada mereka, mereka tidak bersujud,

translations.en.sahih: But those who have disbelieved deny,
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny;
translations.en.yusufali: But on the contrary the Unbelievers reject (it).
translations.id.indonesian: bahkan orang-orang kafir itu mendustakan(nya).

translations.en.sahih: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
translations.en.pickthall: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding.
translations.en.yusufali: But Allah has full knowledge of what they secrete (in their breasts)
translations.id.indonesian: Padahal Allah mengetahui apa yang mereka sembunyikan (dalam hati mereka).

translations.en.sahih: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
translations.en.pickthall: So give them tidings of a painful doom,
translations.en.yusufali: So announce to them a Penalty Grievous,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka beri kabar gembiralah mereka dengan azab yang pedih,

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
transliteration: Illal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon

translations.en.sahih: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
translations.en.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing.
translations.en.yusufali: Except to those who believe and work righteous deeds: For them is a Reward that will never fail.
translations.id.indonesian: tetapi orang-orang yang beriman dan beramal saleh, bagi mereka pahala yang tidak putus-putusnya.
